pairs.why: The two hats are almost identical in shape, finish and color, and neither is clearly closer to the soft, matte-leaning finish of the real cards.
B has a slightly softer, less shiny black finish and a more contained icon framing, a little closer to the real cards; A's brim flare is a touch exaggerated.
B's surface is a little more matte and its proportions slightly tidier, but the difference from A is marginal.
A's brim curls more evenly and reads as a built hat, while B's right brim flares a bit unevenly; the finish is the same on both.
B has a slightly less glossy crown and a more even brim, a hair closer to the real cards' soft finish.
The two are practically identical in rendering, color and construction.
A's brim curls evenly all the way round like a real top hat, while B's brim flares strangely to one side and looks less like a real object.
B's brim is even and well built with a soft matte finish, while A's brim sweeps up oddly on the right.
